requirements.statement: Valid food preparations containing container terms must remain, while arbitrary object-only descriptions without food indication must be rejected.
230g ameixa roxa must resolve deterministically through the local text path to a real plum reference, preserving 230g and avoiding AI/embedding/web dependence.
Specific and semantically meaningful qualifiers such as ameixa em calda must keep precedence over the generic plum alias.
Nutrition fallback decisions must use canonical logInferenceEvent with five low-cardinality reasons, no free user content, no parallel provider telemetry, and best-effort failure handling.
The implementation must use develop as its base branch.
